# The Upper Room Collective

> A faith-driven founder accelerator ecosystem for the world's next unicorn founders, based in the San Francisco Bay Area. It brings together Christian founders, funders and builders through learning, strategy, relationships and resources. Mandate: Serve People. Solve Problems. Scale Impact.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Who we are, who we serve, and our mandate.
- [Founder Run Club](/run-club): Saturday morning runs in Golden Gate Park for faith-driven founders, funders and builders.
- [Founder Masterclasses](/masterclasses): Virtual founder education: ideation, brand development, building to last, fundraising and pivoting.
- [Founder Design Studio](/studio): Strategy, brand identity and venture foundations for visionary founders, by consultation.
- [Join the Collective](/join): Newsletter and community waitlist.
- [Contact](/contact): Partnerships, media and general enquiries.

## Coming soon

- Founder Dinners: invitation-only, curated dinners for founders and funders.
- Founder Podcast: conversations with faith-driven builders.
